findings.item: Re-approved after expanding the CLAUDE.md Glossary entry with the managed-policy scope's exact OS paths (cited to code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, Reference tier), adding a CLAUDE.local.md entry, and wikilinking CLAUDE-file mentions across Domains 1-3 plus three previously-orphaned Glossary entries (.claude/rules/, SKILL.md, REVIEW.md) in this note.

First eval pass rejected for a load-timing self-contradiction (managed/user/project load at launch, directory loads on demand — Glossary and note now agree), an overclaimed citation footer, link-spam in Sec 3.1 (CLAUDE.md linked 4x to the same anchor), and line-wrap regressions. All fixed and re-verified: 12 flashcards, one graph TD, every task 3.1-3.6 has a trap, all wikilinks resolve.

Re-approved after linking every first-mention command/flag in this note to the new Claude Commands.md catalog (/init, /memory, /create_worktree, .claude/commands/, /review, merge_worktree, .claude/skills/, /compact, /clear, -p, --output-format, --json-schema, --bare, --resume, --append-system-prompt, --system-prompt, /code-review, --fix, /install-github-app, --max-turns), and adding a blank callout separator before the CLI-reference citation. Three review rounds caught and fixed: a broken wikilink-with-backtick-alias pattern (SKILL.md/CLAUDE.md/REVIEW.md/.claude/rules/), a factual error in the migrated /review entry (falsely claimed not a real built-in; corrected after live-doc verification), and a quarantine breach (the corrected /review entry initially cited and disclosed a specific quarantined practice-tier sample question; removed). 12 flashcards, one graph TD, trap per task 3.1-3.6, all 67+ vault-wide anchors resolve.

Re-approved after linking this note's first mentions of SKILL.md's frontmatter, plugin, and git worktree to three new Glossary entries (Frontmatter, Plugin, Worktree). Evaluator confirmed all three entries trace cleanly to primary sources and the exam guide, with two non-blocking wording suggestions (Plugin's install path, minor line-wrap tidiness) applied afterward as content-neutral polish. 12 flashcards, one graph TD, trap per task 3.1-3.6, all anchors resolve.

Re-approved after adding a verbatim $ARGUMENTS worked example to Task 3.2 (quoting the course's real create_worktree.md, disclosed as 2 of its 4 steps) and rewriting the Glossary's Worktree entry to be more generic/human-readable per user request. First pass flagged the simplified wording as imprecise (read like a full repo clone rather than a second working folder of the same project; 'main copy' should be 'main branch' to match the source and rest of the vault); both fixed and re-verified with zero remaining findings. 12 flashcards, one graph TD, trap per task 3.1-3.6, all links resolve.

Re-approved after a Skill Glossary entry, a jq Glossary entry, an Output style Glossary entry (with a new '--system-prompt persistence, and how output styles differ' subsection in 3.6), and a .claude/settings.local.json Glossary entry were added and cross-linked, and the vault's scattered .claude/ directory references (previously split between Glossary.md and Claude Commands.md's 'Config directories' section) were consolidated into a new Claude Main Files and Directories.md, with this note's inline links repointed to it. First pass rejected on a genuine load-timing/attribution contradiction in 3.1 (course-material framing applied to a docs-only fact), a -p-vs-CLAUDE.md contradiction in 3.6 left unreconciled, a missing 3.6 skill bullet (feeding the existing test suite into context), run-on sentences, and a missing Subagent wikilink; second pass caught that the 3.6 reconciliation had invented an unsourced claim that the GitHub Action auto-loads CLAUDE.md, and that an unrelated external edit had corrupted the REVIEW.md exam-intel bullet (misspelling, self-contradictory 'non-blocking' qualifier, unsourced example) — both fixed and traced back to source wording. Final pass approved (clarity 4/5) with two non-blocking suggestions (an earlier 'worktree' Glossary link in 3.2, splitting one double-'since' sentence in the output-styles subsection), both applied as content-neutral polish. 12 flashcards, one graph TD (all six tasks now have a diagram leaf), trap per task 3.1-3.6, all wikilinks/anchors resolve into Glossary.md, Claude Commands.md, and Claude Main Files and Directories.md.
